Hawaii braces for Hurricane Lowell, third storm threat this month

Hawaii is preparing for Hurricane Lowell, which has strengthened to a Category 4 storm. This marks the third storm threat to the islands within a month. The hurricane is expected to make a sharp turn, posing a potential close call for Hawaii. Forecasters are providing updates on its trajectory and potential impacts.
